dependencies.jose: native crypto and compact-token header parsing
dependencies.lru-cache: private bounded monotonic cache with fixed stale deadline

changes: Native public JWK import with canonical field encodings, key purpose and algorithm-family checks; immutable signing-key records and lazy once-only PEM export.
Reject ambiguous duplicate signing key IDs and preserve empty IDs as distinct from missing IDs.
Snapshot and validate client configuration; bound HTTP response bytes, key counts, key field sizes and key IDs.
Coalesce concurrent signing-key fetch/import work; cache only successful lookups using monotonic fixed expiry and bounded LRU retention.
Enforce an atomic rolling-minute limit on actual endpoint fetches, including getKeys and getSigningKeys; cache/interceptor hits do not consume capacity.
Total request deadlines include streaming and custom fetchers; reject invalid UTF-8, premature close, unsupported URI schemes, redirects and unsuccessful status codes.
Guard adapter error callbacks, handle rejected error hooks, and require token algorithms to agree with the selected public key.
Bun native crypto rejects secp256k1 and Ed448 JWK imports; these keys are skipped, while native Node supports them.

Opt-in 4.1 stale fallback with monotonic fixed expiry, no fresh re-caching of stale keys, and rejection of malformed or oversized responses. The fallback notification also safely awaits rejected asynchronous hooks.
upstreamTestAdaptations: The request timeout test expects ETIMEDOUT instead of the upstream incidental ECONNRESET.
